video_title: JALEN WILLIAMS TAKES OVER JAPAN!! (PART ONE)

quotes.speaker: Jalen Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Williams on the emotional impact of teammates departing the Thunder
quotes.excerpt: When you win a championship with that set group, they become more than just your teammates.
quotes.quote: It is definitely sad. Those are some of my best friends. I have seen all of them since I have been in the NBA. When you win a championship with that set group, they become more than just your teammates. They are also going to really good situations, so they will have really good years and I am excited for them. But yeah, I was really sad. I am really close with those guys, so I hope they do well.
